title: Cadet Drafter (Civil) - Urban Transport
content_text: Civil Cadet Drafter in Egis Urban Transport team, Queensland: AutoCAD civil drawings for roads, intersections, shared pathways and drainage; GA, typical sections, line marking, signage, construction details; long sections, cross sections, drainage plans; survey and utility data; drawing packages to IFC; drawing registers and revisions; council/TMR standards, Austroads. Entry level for someone studying or about to start a Certificate, Diploma or Degree in drafting or civil engineering; no previous drafting experience required; exposure to AutoCAD, 12d, Civil 3D; driver licence.
